description: React component definitions for a custom Select UI element, utilizing Radix UI primitives and lucide icons, with styling utilities.

methods.name: Select
methods.description: Main wrapper component for the select element, rendering Radix UI's Root.

methods.name: SelectGroup
methods.description: Component for grouping select items, rendering Radix UI's Group.

methods.name: SelectValue
methods.description: Component displaying the selected value, rendering Radix UI's Value.

methods.name: SelectTrigger
methods.description: Component for the trigger button to open the select dropdown, with styling and icon.

methods.name: SelectContent
methods.description: Component for the dropdown content, including viewport and scroll buttons.

methods.name: SelectLabel
methods.description: Component for labeling sections within the select dropdown.

methods.name: SelectItem
methods.description: Component representing an individual selectable item.

methods.name: SelectSeparator
methods.description: Component for visual separation between items.

methods.name: SelectScrollUpButton
methods.description: Button to scroll up within the dropdown.

methods.name: SelectScrollDownButton
methods.description: Button to scroll down within the dropdown.
